title: The Whisper Man
plot_overview: After his young son disappears, a widower seeks help from his estranged father, a retired detective. Together, they confront a chilling case connected to a serial killer the older man once helped put away, forcing them to revisit a dangerous and deeply troubling past.
will_you_like_this: You may enjoy this if you like grim missing-person mysteries, troubled family dynamics, and serial-killer suspense; Not for you if you prefer lighter stories or less disturbing subject matter.
review_summary: Pros: chilling premise; family tension; dark mystery | Cons: grim subject matter; potentially intense; limited review detail
